text: Ciftoree nde Min ɓami e mon aadi teentuɗo njokkon Muusaa kisal won e makko, e jaɓde ko o addi iwde e Alla, Min ɓamti dow mon fello ngo ngam hulɓinde on, Min mbii on: njogoree Tawreeta nde Min ngaddani on nde e soobee e tiiɗnaare, nanee njaɓon ɗofto-ɗon, si ɗuum alaa Min liɓa fello ngo dow mooɗon, mbii-ɗon: min nanirii noppi amen min ngoopiri golle amen, rewde ngaari ndi debbi e ɓerɗe maɓɓe sabu yeddugol maɓɓe. Yo a wii ɓe - Aan Annabi-: bone wonii e ɗum ko goonɗingol mon yamiri on keefeeru, so tawii oɗon ngoonɗini; sabu keefeeru yahdataa e goonɗinal goonga.
